description: Amendment metadata ("Stand") for a German federal law or ordinance: official abbreviation and title, date of promulgation (Ausfertigungsdatum), official publication citation (Fundstelle), the official amendment-status entries (Neufassung/Stand — the act and date that produced the current consolidated text), and the entry-into-force date when Gesetze im Internet publishes one. Use for "what is the current Stand of the BGB" or "when was the current BDSG enacted". Keyless.

law.description: The law or ordinance: its official abbreviation ("BGB", "StGB", "HGB", "BDSG", "GG", "ZPO", "EStG") or (if unambiguous) its official title ("Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch"). Call gesetze_search first if unsure.

name: gesetze_law_info
title: Gesetze Law Info
